title: Hoobuy Fees: Calculate Product, Payment & Shipping Costs
description: Build a Hoobuy total-cost budget with separate product, payment, domestic delivery and international shipping amounts, plus a worked example and checks before paying.
heading: Hoobuy Total Cost Guide: Product, Payment and Shipping Fees
sections: A Hoobuy total-cost estimate starts with the exact product option and ends with the cost of receiving the parcel. The price on a spreadsheet is only one part. Keep the item price, domestic delivery, payment costs, optional services and international shipping separate. Add destination charges only from information that applies to your own shipment. A number that has not been confirmed should remain unknown, rather than silently becoming zero.

This guide explains how to build that budget and reconcile later changes. It does not publish a universal Hoobuy service-fee percentage, payment rate or shipping price: those figures need to be checked in the live account and route quotation. The examples below are invented arithmetic examples, clearly labelled, so you can replace every amount with your own confirmed values.
1. Start with one item, one option and one currency

Open the original listing and select the intended size, colour and quantity. A low price on a product card may refer to another option, a minimum quantity or an older listing. Record the amount and currency after selecting your option. Keep the seller URL and a dated screenshot together. This gives you a useful reference if the agent later asks you to approve a difference.

Use one currency for the working budget. If the seller charges in CNY and your payment account uses another currency, preserve both amounts instead of replacing the original. Record the conversion rate shown for the actual payment, including its date. A search-engine exchange-rate estimate is useful for planning, but it does not establish what your bank or payment provider will charge.
Seller delivery amount and package count
Checkout fee lines and final payment amount
Route, packed weight, dimensions and quote
When the shipment details are known

Do not count a charge twice. If a checkout total already includes domestic delivery, either record that inclusive total or separate its components, but do not add the delivery line again. Apply the same rule to a payment fee included in the amount charged to your card. When the description is unclear, ask what the quoted amount includes before treating it as the final total.

Suppose two selected products cost CNY 180 and CNY 120. Assume domestic delivery is CNY 12, an optional service costs CNY 8, the separately displayed payment cost is CNY 10, and the international shipping estimate is CNY 190. These are example inputs, not Hoobuy prices or a quote for any destination. The known subtotal is CNY 520: 180 + 120 + 12 + 8 + 10 + 190.

If the final shipping amount becomes CNY 220, the subtotal becomes CNY 550. The increase is CNY 30, not a second CNY 220 payment to add on top of the estimate in your cost ledger. Keep an estimated column and a final column so the replacement is explicit. Any unconfirmed destination charge remains outside this subtotal and should be marked as pending.

The purpose of this example is to make the missing information visible. A budget of CNY 520 with destination costs unconfirmed is different from an all-inclusive promise of CNY 520. You can reserve your own contingency for uncertainty, but identify it as your planning buffer. It is not an additional platform fee and should not be presented as one.
4. Check why the shipping estimate changes

Before warehouse packing, the total weight and outer dimensions may be estimates. Packaging can change both. A bulky but light item may produce a different chargeable weight from a compact item with the same scale weight. Compare the selected route's actual rules, including its volume divisor, minimum charge, rounding and eligible item types. Do not assume that every route prices only the physical kilograms.

For a purely mathematical example, a 40 × 30 × 25 cm parcel has a volume of 30,000 cubic centimetres. A divisor of 6,000 gives 5 kg of volumetric weight; a divisor of 5,000 gives 6 kg. Neither divisor is a promise about your route. Use the live route rule, then check whether its price also includes additional services or surcharges. Record the dimensions before comparing two estimates.
5. Compare payment choices using the amount actually charged

If several payment methods are offered, compare the same order and currency at the same time. Record the order amount, any separately displayed payment cost, the exchange conversion and the final amount payable. A low advertised percentage is not enough to compare methods when conversion and fixed charges differ. Stop before confirming a payment if a line cannot be explained from the checkout screen.

A wallet top-up and a purchase paid from that wallet are related movements, not necessarily two separate purchase costs. Record money entering the wallet as funding, then record the order payment against the relevant order. For a refund, distinguish a requested refund, a wallet credit and money returned to the original payment method. Count the settled amount rather than assuming that every pending credit is already available.
6. Decide whether an optional service is useful

Choose additional photographs, measurements, packing or other services because they answer a specific question or protect a specific item. Write the question first. For example, a flat chest measurement may help resolve a size uncertainty, while another general photograph may not. Check the current availability and price in the item record. This guide does not assume that any particular service is free or offered for every item.

Compare the service cost with the decision it enables. If extra evidence could prevent sending the wrong size internationally, it may be useful before parcel submission. If you already have the needed measurement, a duplicate request may add no value. Keep the service confirmation with the item ID so it does not become an unexplained expense in a combined parcel budget.
7. Reconcile adjustments without losing the original quote

Save the initial order total, any requested adjustment, your response and the final settled amount. When an outstanding balance appears, identify whether it belongs to product purchase, domestic delivery or parcel shipping. These are different stages and may use different records. Compare the requested difference with the underlying change instead of sending another payment just because a status label looks urgent.

Before paying for a parcel, reconcile the item list, optional services, packed measurements, selected route and amount due. After shipment, update the final column when the account records a settlement or refund. Keep the original estimate for comparison. This lets you see whether the main uncertainty came from the product option, packing, currency conversion or the route itself.
Questions to answer before you pay
Does the spreadsheet price include shipping?
Do not assume so. Confirm the selected item price, seller delivery amount and international parcel quote separately. A product card is a research lead, not an all-inclusive checkout.
Can I use one fixed Hoobuy fee percentage?
Use the fee lines displayed for your actual transaction. A single percentage cannot represent every payment method, optional service, route or later adjustment.
Should unknown charges be entered as zero?
No. Mark them as unconfirmed and identify the source needed to resolve them. Zero means a cost has been confirmed as absent; unknown means the budget is incomplete.

For the next order, complete the product and domestic-delivery lines first, then save a current shipping estimate with its inputs. Review the unresolved fields before committing to a large purchase. A useful total-cost budget is an auditable record of your own transaction, with assumptions visible and later changes traceable.

title: Hoobuy Links Not Working? Taobao & Weidian Fixes
description: Troubleshoot Hoobuy product links by checking the original seller page, item ID, short link and selected variant. Know when manual ordering helps and when to stop.
heading: Hoobuy Links Not Working? Taobao and Weidian Troubleshooting
sections: When a Hoobuy product link does not work, first check whether the original seller page still opens. If the source listing is unavailable, changing the agent link cannot restore it. If the source page works but the product does not load in Hoobuy, compare the URL format, product identity and current ordering options. This distinction prevents repeated conversions of a link that no longer points to a usable item.

This guide covers product discovery links from Taobao, Weidian and shared spreadsheets. It does not promise that every item can be purchased or shipped. A working link establishes only that a page can be opened. Stock, selected options, platform restrictions and destination eligibility still need to be checked separately before payment.
1. Identify which part of the journey failed
The spreadsheet link gives an error
The saved source and last review date
A short link opens an unrelated page
The final destination and product identity
Copy the full listing URL from the seller page
The seller page works, but import fails
The exact URL and selected option
The listing opens but an option is unavailable
Size, colour, quantity and stock message
Choose a confirmed option or ask the seller

Write down the error text before changing anything. A blank page, a login prompt, an unavailable variant and a purchase restriction are different problems. Save the time and the link you tried. If you report only that the link is broken, support has to reconstruct the missing steps. A short description of the exact failure is more useful than several repeated submissions.

Open the product from the seller's own page when possible. A message copied from a shopping app may contain a title, promotional text, a short URL and a sharing code together. Copy the actual URL rather than pasting the entire message into a product importer. If a short link redirects successfully, check the final page before saving its address. Do not assume that the first visible brand name identifies the website you reached.

The hostname and item identifier should match the product you intend to buy. Common listing formats include a Taobao item page with an id parameter and a Weidian item page with an itemID parameter. Treat these as format clues, not a reason to manufacture a URL using a guessed number. Preserve the complete valid address from the original listing and let the current platform handle supported formats.
3. Compare identity before converting the link

Record the item ID, seller name, product title and one distinctive option. Compare those details after opening an agent page or converter result. A familiar photograph alone is weak evidence because different sellers can reuse images. An item ID combined with the expected seller and variant is a stronger check. If the details differ, stop and treat the result as a different listing until you can explain the mismatch.

Consider an illustrative spreadsheet entry for a black jacket in size M. A converted page might open a similar jacket with a different size chart, or the same listing with the cheapest accessory selected. Neither result is ready to order simply because the image looks right. Re-select the intended option, read its price and confirm the quantity. Save the resulting option text in your order notes.
4. Distinguish a formatting issue from an unavailable product

A formatting issue exists when the original page is accessible but the address copied into the agent form is incomplete or mixed with other text. Start by copying the full URL again. Check for an accidentally truncated item ID or punctuation pasted at the end. If the site offers a normal product-search field, try the clean source URL there once and record the result.

An unavailable listing needs a different response. If the seller deleted the page, removed your option or stopped accepting orders, a converter cannot recreate stock. Search for a replacement only if you are willing to evaluate a new source. Compare its seller, measurements, price and return conditions from the beginning. Keep the old row marked as unavailable so you do not repeatedly return to the same dead link.
5. Use manual ordering only when the current service supports it

Hoobuy's public manual-purchase form includes fields for the product link, name, specifications, photographs, unit price, quantity and domestic delivery amount. That makes a complete source record useful when automatic import cannot represent the listing. The presence of a form does not guarantee acceptance of every product. Read the live instructions and confirm any uncertainty before submitting a paid order.

Prepare the requested fields from the actual seller page. Write the exact colour and size rather than asking an agent to choose from a photograph. If the listing uses option codes, preserve them together with their visible descriptions. Record the currency, quantity and delivery charge separately. An incomplete manual order can turn a link-format problem into an avoidable purchasing mistake.

Manual purchase and parcel forwarding are different workflows. If you already bought directly from the seller, you may need a supported forwarding record with the correct domestic tracking details rather than another purchase request. Check which service matches the situation before submitting anything. Duplicating a purchase because a link failed can create two orders instead of fixing the first one.
6. Treat restriction messages as information to resolve

If a page says an item cannot be purchased or shipped, read the message and check the current platform or route rules. Removing a warning from the screen does not change whether the item is eligible. Ask official support about the exact product and destination if the explanation is unclear. Do not promise a buyer that a successful link conversion means a restricted item is accepted.

Also separate a website login requirement from product eligibility. Use the official website address you already trust for account access. A third-party converter or spreadsheet should not need your Hoobuy password, payment details or private order credentials to explain a URL. Share only the public listing information needed for troubleshooting, and remove private account data from screenshots.

Send the original listing URL, the exact error message, the selected option and whether the seller page opens normally. Include the time of your attempt and the relevant order reference only through the platform's private support channel. State the decision you need: whether the link is supported, whether manual ordering is available, or whether the item is ineligible. Keep the request focused on one unresolved point.

After receiving an answer, update the spreadsheet row with the checked date and the outcome. Use clear states such as working source, option unavailable, replacement needed or awaiting support. Keep a replacement under a new row or preserve the previous URL in a history field. This makes the spreadsheet useful for the next visitor instead of presenting an old link as freshly verified.
Will a link converter make every Taobao or Weidian item purchasable?
No. It may change a supported URL format, but stock, option availability and platform restrictions remain separate checks.
Why does the imported price differ from the spreadsheet?
Compare the exact variant, quantity, currency and date. A spreadsheet price may be old or may refer to another option. Confirm the payable amount in the current order.
What should I do if the seller page has disappeared?
Mark the source as unavailable. If you find a replacement, verify it as a new listing instead of assuming it has the same seller, measurements or conditions.

A reliable fix ends with a verified product identity and an explained next step. It does not end merely with a page that loads. Once the source and option are confirmed, move on to the QC and total-cost checks before deciding whether the product belongs in your parcel.

title: Hoobuy Shipping to Brazil: Costs, Weight & Tracking
description: Prepare a Hoobuy shipping quote for Brazil, compare actual and volumetric weight, check recipient details and follow the correct carrier and import-status records.
heading: Hoobuy Shipping to Brazil: Quote, Weight and Tracking Guide
sections: To estimate Hoobuy shipping to Brazil, start with the destination, item category, parcel weight and outer dimensions. Then compare the eligible routes shown for those inputs. The cheapest product price does not tell you the cost of receiving the parcel. International freight, optional services and any destination charges need separate checks. This guide helps you prepare those checks without inventing a universal price per kilogram or a guaranteed delivery time.

Brazilian buyers often search for frete, peso volumétrico and rastreamento. These refer to three connected tasks: obtaining a shipping quote, understanding the weight used for charging and following the parcel after dispatch. Keep them in that order. A tracking number cannot explain an unverified quote, and an estimated shipping duration does not prove that customs processing has finished.
1. Prepare the information before requesting a quote
Brazil and the recipient's actual delivery details
Comparing a quote for another country
Item categories, quantities and any restricted features
Assuming all products use the same routes
Packed parcel weight with the displayed unit
Outer length, width and height in the required unit
Using garment measurements instead of box dimensions
Comparing different packages as if they were identical
Date, route name, inputs and included charges

Before warehouse packing, some inputs may only be estimates. Label them clearly and keep the expected package shape realistic. A jacket can be light but bulky; a rigid box can increase dimensions even when its contents weigh little. If you are considering removing packaging, check that the item can still be protected adequately. A smaller box is useful only if it remains suitable for the contents.

Actual weight is the mass measured on a scale. Volumetric weight is a calculation based on the parcel's outer volume and a divisor specified by the route. The applicable charging rule may compare the two, impose a minimum or round the result. Read the route's own wording rather than assuming one formula applies to every Brazil service. The estimator is a starting point; final packing can change the inputs.

For an illustrative calculation, suppose a packed parcel weighs 3 kg and measures 40 × 30 × 25 cm. Its volume is 30,000 cubic centimetres. Dividing by 6,000 produces 5 kg; dividing by 5,000 produces 6 kg. These are hypothetical comparisons, not confirmed divisors for a Brazilian route. If the relevant route charges on the higher result, the scale weight alone would understate the charging basis.

If the same contents can safely fit in a 40 × 30 × 20 cm package, the volume becomes 24,000 cubic centimetres. The same illustrative divisors give 4 kg and 4.8 kg. Compare the resulting live quotes, including any packing charge, before deciding that repacking saves money. Do not translate a reduction in calculated kilograms directly into a fixed cash saving without the route's actual tariff.

Use the same contents, destination, dimensions and packing choice for each route comparison. Record the quoted amount, currency, charging basis, item restrictions and what the estimate includes. If one route accepts your items and another does not, their prices are not interchangeable choices. A route name or a social-media recommendation alone does not establish that the route is available for your current parcel.

Treat a displayed delivery estimate as planning information, not a personal guarantee. Ask what stage the estimate covers if that is unclear. Seller dispatch, warehouse processing, international transport, customs handling and local delivery are separate events. A delay before the parcel reaches the international carrier cannot be evaluated only against an advertised international transit range.
4. Check recipient information and official import guidance

Correios advises that imported shipments need the recipient's CPF information and that the recipient name should match the registration with Receita Federal. Check the current official guidance and the fields required by the selected shipping service. Enter personal details only in the appropriate official or service account. Do not put a CPF, full address or payment record into a public product spreadsheet.

Import charges and procedures depend on the applicable rules and shipment details. This guide does not provide a fixed Brazilian tax rate or assume that a Hoobuy parcel belongs to a particular tax programme. Consult Receita Federal and the actual carrier for the current requirements. Keep purchase evidence and an accurate contents record so that any request for supporting information can be answered from real documents.

For postal shipments handled by Correios, use the official Minhas Importações service to check notices and required actions. For a courier shipment, follow that courier's official process. Do not assume that every Hoobuy shipping line hands the parcel to Correios. Identify the carrier from the parcel record and the actual tracking handoff before deciding which portal should show an update.
5. Keep domestic and international tracking separate

The seller's delivery within China and the international parcel to Brazil are different journeys. Save the domestic tracking number against the purchased item, then save the international number against the packed parcel. If several items are consolidated, record which warehouse items belong to that parcel. This avoids reading a seller's domestic delivery scan as confirmation that the international shipment has arrived.

When a new tracking number appears, check the carrier and the latest event on its official tracking page. A number being created is not the same evidence as physical carrier acceptance. Save the event text and date. If a later carrier uses a different number, keep both numbers and the handoff evidence rather than replacing the first record and losing the connection.
6. Investigate a tracking pause using the last confirmed event

Start with the last verified handoff: warehouse packing, carrier acceptance, international movement, import processing or local delivery. Then identify which organisation can explain the next step. An order-purchase question belongs with the agent; a current local-delivery event may need the final carrier. Include the parcel number, last event and relevant date in a private support request instead of asking several parties to reconstruct the entire history.

Check whether the tracking or import portal requests a document, correction or payment. Follow the current official notice and its stated deadline. Open the official portal directly instead of using an unexpected payment message as your only source. Receita Federal offers an international-purchase status service for eligible shipment records; the required identifiers should be entered there privately, not posted in a comment or shared sheet.
7. Use a final checklist before parcel submission

Confirm the item list, review the available QC photographs, resolve any size or quantity mismatch, and choose the packing configuration. Check the recipient details, destination, route eligibility and final amount due. Save the quote with its inputs before payment. If an important fact remains unresolved, such as whether an item is accepted on the route, obtain clarification before treating the parcel as ready to ship.
What is the cheapest Hoobuy shipping line to Brazil?
There is no reliable universal answer. Compare eligible live quotes for the same parcel, destination and packing choice, including the costs and restrictions shown for each route.
Does a shipping estimate include every destination charge?
Check the scope of the actual quote. Do not assume freight includes every import or local-service charge; confirm applicable requirements with official sources and the carrier.
Why does the Brazil tracking page show no result yet?
First confirm the carrier and whether the international parcel has been accepted. You may be using a domestic seller number, a newly created number or a number not handled by that tracking service.

A useful Brazil shipping plan connects the original quote to the final package and then to the correct tracking record. Keep those records together, update only confirmed changes and separate an estimate from an actual event. That gives you a practical basis for comparing costs and asking for help without relying on unsupported promises.
